_comment: model -> view (.tsx) and entry component. `converted`: the view was made from the model's official chat template by tools/jinja2tsx.py; it renders a list of messages to the official tokens. `shared`: the model was registered with another model's view, because its chat template is the same text (tools/add_model.py); it is checked against its own tokenizer. `agent`: what an agent needs to read the model's replies, measured from the view by tools/protocol_survey.rs and written by tools/measure_agents.py (stop, in_think, syntax, alternate, system_role, tools, parts, special). A deployment may name any model here as its binding's template (org/name): views/template_apps/chat.tsx renders it.
